head: 0db8d9a05dd984f4df2781d8e6dd237eaa70e32a
scope: Native Finance posting for matched supplier-bill sources: Commerce fulfillment and People expense-claim owner witnesses, with Finance-owned journal/Money/replay/version/audit in the same serializable unit.

implemented.finance: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence now accepts a PgSupplierBillSource witness. Standalone stays source-free; commerce_fulfillment and expense_claim require a current owner source whose invoice_id is the posted invoice. The invoice update no longer hard-codes source_type='standalone'.
implemented.locks: SupplierBillPostSources locks Commerce/People sources before Commercial authority, Finance and Files.
implemented.no_fallback: Assemblies without the source port keep SUPPLIER_BILL_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED for non-standalone bills.

gates.new_case: supplier_bill_posts_a_commerce_fulfillment_source_with_its_owner_witness (journal lines 25,000 expense / 26,750 payable / 1,750 input tax, invoice posted, source_type retained)
gates.format: rustfmt check pass for the changed files

browser.detail: The Finance invoice detail now renders for the available account after seeding reviewed finance/supply/sales package grants and repairing the session work-context row. The draft commerce bill BILL-C53367514A545C51A0EABBE8 opens with its source facts. The UI posting form is still blocked by the Finance approver flow primary (the current user has no acme-co staff engagement), and the direct native route falls back to the retained TypeScript posting path because the configured native Finance API at 3198 is bound to the clone erpx_dev_rust_* databases, while the dev invoice lives in erpx_dev_h001_write. The native API rejects the shared DB with PRIVATE_API_SCHEMA_MISMATCH even after the shared migrations. No browser acceptance for matched posting is claimed.
browser.observed_ts_error: GOODS_VALUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED from the retained TypeScript commerce goods-accounting path; this is not the native post result.

dev_data_seeded: company_package_grants acme-co finance/supply/sales active with reviewed grant events (development only).
flow_defaults acme-co invoice finance_approver primary usr_jesadakorn revision 0 (development only).
active_work_contexts repaired for the current disposable browser sessions so the Finance presentation guard matches the selected holding-owner assignment.
remaining: Finance approver team membership/primary for the current dev user (or a Finance-authorized account) so the UI posting form renders.
Native Finance API bound to the shared development databases (or a clone-DB browser fixture) so the native matched post can be exercised in the browser.
Expense-claim invoice creation when finance_expenses.invoice_id is null; the current native post handles the existing draft invoice link only.
Finance remains partial at 9/10 workflows and is not owner 6/41.
